sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at the main park entrance after a night of rain.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I want a flat walk to the garden before lunch.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I open the park website at the information desk.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, is this the page with today's trail status?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, we keep that page up to date.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It says the riverside trail is closed, right?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, it's still muddy after last night's rain.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Is there another way to get to the garden?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, you can take the garden path from the south gate.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I walk to the south gate from here?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, just follow the road outside the park fence.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: How will I know when I'm at the south gate?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: There's a little blue sign with the gate name on it.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Is the garden path flat once I'm inside?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, it's flat, and you won't have to climb any steps.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I pull up the park map on my phone.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Do I go across the bridge to get there?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: As you come up to the bridge, turn left just before you reach it.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, did you say before or after the bridge?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Before the bridge, turn left.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So I don't go across the bridge at all?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, the road takes you straight to the gate.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Will I see a sign for the garden once I'm inside?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, look for the green sign on your right.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll check the trail status again before tomorrow's walk.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Good idea, we update it when a trail opens again.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I head out and turn left before the bridge.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At the blue sign, I go in through the gate.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I follow the green sign and reach the garden.
